name: OnePlus Buds (HeyMelody app, 5-band)
notes: HeyMelody app's 5-band custom EQ for OnePlus/Oppo TWS earbuds that support it (e.g. Buds Pro 2/3 series). Publicly confirmed: 5 bands spanning ~31 Hz-16 kHz. NOT publicly confirmed: the exact center frequency of each band, or the gain range/step -- those aren't disclosed anywhere public. Frequencies here are a standard logarithmic spacing across the confirmed range (not read from the app itself); gain range/step are a typical consumer-TWS assumption (+/-6 dB, 0.5 dB). Correct via the manual editor if you have the device and it differs.
